answer: Reaching the summit of the reputation ladder requires sustained legitimate participation, so an attacker forging many sybils must pay the full stake plus computation per identity, making mass fakery economically ruinous. At each dawn, agents must stake a bonded deposit and solve a rotating proof-of-work tied to their identity, forming a trust vine where each new node references two existing members. From Agent0044's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
